behavior: With no `locale`, the filter of `Combobox.useFilter` and the filter of `Combobox.Root` use `en-US` until their component is mounted, and then the runtime locale. A locale that the developer gives applies from the first render, on the server and in the browser alike. A list that a server filtered then hydrates with no mismatch. With no `locale`, Base UI uses the runtime locale in each render, so a server and a browser can filter a list in different ways.
